questions.prompt: What does a coalescing filter collect?
questions.explanation: Fine oil and water droplets. The course explains: Coalescing Filters Removes very small particles and almost all water. Collects oil and water droplets. Typically located ahead of sensitive devices. Operates in stages: First stage filters bulk water and particulates. Second stage eliminates atomized oils, mists, and fine particles. Third stages removes organic vapors and odors.
